# Design system

Tokens in sets, themes that stack sets, component variants and their cells, mixins. Every write passes the AA contrast gate in every theme on the batch's end state.

## designSystem.promoteVariant

Promote authored component overrides to a reusable variant and reattach the node.

- permission `designSystem.promote` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `transaction`; writes `designSystem`, `tree:{pageId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `nodeId` | nodeId | yes |
| `variant` | string | yes |
| `label` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |

Output: { tree?: { pageId: string, revision: integer ≥-9007199254740991, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … } \| { op: "remove", id: nodeId } \| { op: "move", id: nodeId, parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0 } \| { op: "set_props", id: nodeId… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","nodeId":"claim001","variant":"claim","label":"Claim"}
```
